name: THE UNDERTAKER
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO HIM: on the floor before the table's middle, clear of him at its right end (errata 86 C).
note: THE UNDERTAKER, never named (doc 27 note 2), at the viewing table -- the room's one working surface (doc 26) -- planing pine. Doc 27's examine layer is his only description: 'A man in his fifties in a clean apron, doing something careful with a plane' (errata 86 B). Drawn first in room-13's composition master beside Thad, then alone on magenta in five poses against a side-by-side with Thad (room-13 operation 3), keyed by tools/art/room13-undertaker.py. BEHIND THE TABLE: the sheet stops at the table top, so `y` is the cut row, not his feet. Present in every act.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for the undertaker.

sprite.frameNote: 0 turning the plane in his hands, looking at it · 1 breath (derived) · 2 sighting along its sole · 3 running a thumb along the blade · 4 looking up, the plane at his chest. Breathing on 0 and 1; every `breakEvery` seconds one break (errata 77).
sprite.redrawn: Errata 111 (Tyler, 2026-11-06): drawn from the locked cast master, cast-unify operation 17 (reference/cast-unify-15.txt). Doc 27: 'doing something careful with a plane' -- he holds it in every pose, at his chest. Drawn planing on the bench (operations 15, 16), the plane overhung the bench's front edge, which slants as steeply as its back, at any size near his; so nothing of him touches the bench. Cut with its own pixels and a clean edge, registered on the head and the waist row, head matched to the drawing it replaces. Its own file: tools/art/room13-undertaker.py writes the old path.
sprite.waistOnNote: The plate row the figure's waist ends on at his x: the bench's back edge, y 505. The edge SLANTS (y 496 to 514 across his width), so he is placed with his waist on its lowest row and matted column by column along it (tools/art/waist-matte.py): the bench is in front of him all the way along. Held by tests/counter-surface.test.mjs against the plate.
